Scenario: Session expires on a user-controlled device
Required outcome: State becomes LIMITED_ACCESS; pause, revoke, block, report, and history remain available

Scenario: User tries to send in LIMITED_ACCESS
Required outcome: Send is blocked pending fresh user verification; saved draft remains available
Revocation succeeds immediately and is reflected in later controlled rendering

Scenario: User pauses in every access state
Required outcome: Pause succeeds in every state without loss of privacy settings
Existing session is invalidated; lost device cannot render private content; another device can begin continuity
State becomes protective read-only; messages and sensitive profile fields do not render
Only that adapter is paused; Hearthline Core and other adapters remain unaffected

Scenario: Biometric is unavailable but device PIN or security key is available
Required outcome: User can attempt a registered alternative authenticator without account penalty

Scenario: WebAuthn is unavailable on current browser
Required outcome: No password fallback is presented; continuity guidance is available
State becomes CONTINUITY_ACTIVE; safety controls stay enabled and high-impact actions stay disabled
State becomes CONTINUITY_AVAILABLE; user can resume another permitted path
State becomes RESTORED, notifications occur through approved channels, and cooldown policy applies
Request is denied; no visibility or ranking effect occurs

Scenario: Lantern requests recovery-stage meaning from access state
Required outcome: Request is denied; access state cannot produce health or recovery inference
Validator fails if any state loses pause, revoke, block, report, history, or continuity guidance

Scenario: A stale client tries to expand disclosure after access degradation
Required outcome: Server rejects the action and requires current verification
